$description: Tier 2, theme 'light'. Default for screens in light mode. Every theme defines the same token names; only the references change.

subtle.$description: All small and supporting text: labels, captions, header and footer, secondary numbers.

accent.$description: Terracotta. Use sparingly, only on words or marks that carry meaning.

default.$description: Hairlines and dividers. Decorative, not for meaning.

line.$description: Connectors and arrows in diagrams. Needs 3:1 against every background the diagram can sit on.
